claim: Where the compiled artifact asserts that the answered category affords an activity AND the coverage layer surveyed the cell the search was centred on and holds nothing there, the answer carries a coverage-qualified absence observation. Everywhere else the route is silent.
asymmetry: A lookup answering `[]` under exclusion-grade coverage is a fact; the same `[]` under `source_present`, or with no coverage row at all, is silence. The control groups put the same query and the same empty answer on the silent side of that line.
coverageLayerNote: The #1964 pilot: `mailwoman gazetteer build poi-coverage --category pharmacy --region "Île-de-France"`, build-local, ODbL, 290 res-6 cells all at basis `surveyed` and completeness 0.6665, 88 of them holding zero rows. Build-local by construction, so the file is not committed and not published — a run without it refuses at construction rather than reporting an empty board. The same file is the poi.db the executor queries, so the answer and the coverage claim come from one artifact.

rowsNote: Anchors were selected cell-first: the pilot layer's own zero-observed cells were enumerated, gazetteer places whose coordinates fall inside one were collected, and a place was admitted only when the pipeline's resolved search centre landed back in the same cell. No street line is written by hand anywhere in this file. A cell centroid is a coordinate, and the anchor a row carries is a place the gazetteer already holds — not an address composed to reach one. A row's registered outcome binds to the categories the layer surveyed. An activity phrase reaches a SET of categories, and the anchor's country binds that set before the search (#1999); a row whose set the binding decides states the searched set it is graded on in `searchedCategories`, and the runner refuses a row that fired or refused over a set nobody registered (#1998).
decisionRule: HOLDS — every registered row produced the outcome registered for it.
BREACHED — any row did not, whether it fired where silence was registered, stayed silent where the observation was registered, or stayed silent for a reason nobody registered.
There is no middle decision. The claim is a conjunction over the row set, and a conjunction with a tolerance is a different claim.
